# omx loudlevel

Holds a signal at a loudness target by moving its gain slowly, with a gate so pauses are left alone.

- CLAP id: `org.openmixer.loudlevel`
- LV2 URI: `urn:openmixer:loudlevel`
- Parameters: 5, plus the host's bypass

## Panel

![The panel of omx loudlevel, drawn from its declaration](../images/panels/omx-loudlevel.png)

The panel as a host draws it from the declaration alone, every control at its default (`make panel-images`: omx-panel lays it out and its renderer draws it). Its sections and their controls, in order:

| Section | Controls |
|---|---|
| Loudlevel | Target, Range, Speed, Gate, Window |

| Direction | Name | Role | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| in | in | main | 2 (stereo) |

## Pages

A page is where a host shows a parameter. In LV2 each page is a port group, `pg:group <urn:openmixer:loudlevel#<symbol>>`, whose `lv2:displayPriority` is the number below (a host that shows the higher first, as Zynthian does, shows the pages in port order). In CLAP each page is the module of its parameters (`clap_param_info.module`), the page labels joined by `/`.

| Page | LV2 group symbol | Priority | CLAP module | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loudlevel | `loudlevel` | 1 | `Loudlevel` | 5 |

## Parameters

Ids are the order below, 0 to 4; a parameter appended later takes the next id. The bypass's id is its own (below).

| Id | Symbol | Name | Unit | Min | Max | Default | Step or values | Flags | Page (priority) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `targetLufs` | Target | dB | -40 | -6 | -23 | continuous, linear | automatable | Loudlevel (1) |
| 1 | `rangeDb` | Range | dB | 0 | 24 | 0 | continuous, linear | automatable | Loudlevel (1) |
| 2 | `speedDbPerS` | Speed | dB/s | 0.1 | 6 | 1 | continuous, linear | automatable | Loudlevel (1) |
| 3 | `gateLufs` | Gate | dB | -70 | -30 | -50 | whole steps | automatable | Loudlevel (1) |
| 4 | `window` | Window |  | 0 | 1 | Short-term (1) | 0 Momentary, 1 Short-term | automatable | Loudlevel (1) |

## Bypass

CLAP: the host's bypass, a parameter named Bypass at id 2147418112 (0x7FFF0000) in every plugin, flagged automatable, stepped and bypass; 0 is processing, 1 bypassed. The id never moves when a parameter is appended.
LV2: the port `enabled` (`lv2:designation lv2:enabled`) at index 0, 1 is processing, 0 is bypassed; the output port `latency` at index 1 reports the latency in frames. Both come before the audio and parameter ports in every plugin, so neither moves; a preset or a session names a port by its symbol.
